headline: Sabadell Reports 13% Rise in Q3 Recurring Profit, Sees Higher 2026 Costs
summary: Banco Sabadell reported a 13% quarter-on-quarter increase in third-quarter recurring profit while projecting higher cost growth for 2026.
why: Banco Sabadell is a major Spanish financial institution, and its earnings reports provide insight into European banking sector net interest income and operating expenses.

impacts.name: Banco Sabadell
impacts.why: Higher recurring quarterly profits indicate solid underlying banking operations despite cost inflation warnings.
